title: Dependencies and dispatch chains
note: Local queues materialize independently of optional GitHub issue publication and are ordered dependencies-first; sync refuses dependency cycles and unknown dependencies. Advance selects each lane's first planned task whose dependencies are complete, so a waiting queue head never holds back a ready task, and refuses by name with chain_busy, chain_waiting, chain_complete or chain_queue_inconsistent. Conduct advances every idle lane at fan-out and runs each task's gates, Tester and lane advance as its Engineer returns. Concurrency follows the harness manifest's parallel_subagents fact; a harness without supported runs one sub-agent at a time and records the serial deferral. Ordering between lanes must be a real task dependency; plan prose alone does not hold. The current work holder retries items.github_sync without replacing existing chains or lane assignments. Source regression proof does not establish deployed admission.
